bibl.title: New Inscriptions in UK Collections Part I: Unpublished Ancient Greek Inscriptions from Museums in Aberdeen, Bristol and Edinburgh
bibl.seg: Paul Liddel, New Inscriptions in UK Collections Part I: Unpublished Ancient Greek Inscriptions from Museums in Aberdeen, Bristol and Edinburgh
bibl.note: See in part. pp. 97-98: Bristol Museum and Art Gallery, No. 2. Fragment of a funerary inscription for a woman (H4318). Provenance unknown (accessioned among material from Elephantine and 'Dekek' in Nubia). 7th century AD or later?; - 98-101: National Museums Scotland, No. 1. Epitaph of Demokles Messenios (A.1936.499). Possibly area of Alexandria, 2nd century BC?; - 102-103: No. 2. Epitaph of Paulos (A.1909.484). Possibly Latopolis (Esna), ca. 500-700 AD?; - 103-104: No. 3. Epitaph of Ammon (A.1910.100) [= S.E.G. LVI, 1992]. Latopolis (Esna), ca. 500-700 AD?
